message.reasoning_content:
The kernel drops the ReLU residual. Need to check whether the residual can exceed 1.0 in absolute error over the box. Compute the maximum of residual term over the box analytically/numerically. The residual is sum 0.25*relu(dot(W[j],x)-b[j]). Max over box of relu(dot - b). Since b[j]=0.75*sum|W[j]|, max of dot(W[j],x) = sum|W[j]|, so max pre-activation = 0.25*sum|W[j]|. Times c=0.25 per neuron, sum over 6 neurons: need actual values. Let's compute.
